name: Orchid Mantis Swarm
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia World Guide

generalAbilities.name: Floral Camouflage
generalAbilities.description: When Hiding, the orchid mantis swarm is Concealed by any amount of leaves or petals, even if they aren't thick enough to make other creatures concealed.

generalAbilities.name: Low-Light Vision
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

The monster can see in dim light as though it were bright light, so it ignores the Concealed condition due to dim light.

offensiveAbilities.name: Biting Blossom
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that fail this save also take 1d4 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drifting Petals
offensiveAbilities.description:
The swarm Flies. Each creature whose space it moves through must attempt a DC 24 Will Saving Throw save or be transfixed by their blossom-like bodies.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled and Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is Blinded and Stupefied 2 for 1 round.
